doc: If status flag D_800847D0.flags1 & 0x400 is set, computes a pitch-bend value: pitch = (D_80084858.field8 * D_8008480C[0]) / 32767 (16-bit signed truncating division by 32767, the max positive s16 -- a percentage-of-full-scale calc), then tmp = pitch * D_80084858.field10 and pitch = tmp / 128 (division-by-power-of-2 truncation, stored back into a 16-bit var). Dispatches the resulting pitch value via func_8005A56C(0, pitch, pitch) (same value on both channel args, SPU command mode 0).
